title: rubus montanus var. citriodorus
intro: Rubus montanus var. citriodorus, commonly known as Mountain Raspberry or Lemon Raspberry, is a rare and lesser-known species of raspberry native to the mountainous regions of East Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rubus montanus var. citriodorus include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote wound healing, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents present in the plant, such as quercetin, kaempferol, and gallic acid, contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
